name: Wynter
description_en:
Wynter is a B2B market-research service for testing messaging and surveying or interviewing target buyers. Audience selection uses professional criteria such as role, seniority, industry and company size.

It is particularly relevant to a go-to-market question, such as whether a landing-page proposition is clear to intended buyers. That differs from instrumenting application sessions or proving a live conversion increase.
description_zh:
Wynter 是 B2B 市场研究服务，用于测试文案并向目标买家发问卷或开展访谈。人群选择采用职位、级别、行业和公司规模等职业条件。

它适合回答上市推广问题，例如落地页价值主张是否能被目标买家理解。这与采集应用会话或证明线上转化提升不同。

official_check.scope: Public official documentation research; no account, purchase, live workflow, performance, owner identity or publication approval verified.

review_notes: Original English research and corresponding Chinese translation by Codex AI; vendor documentation is not independent product testing.
Examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese text does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_en: Buyer research rather than generic usability analytics
sections.title_zh: 买家研究与通用可用性分析有区别
sections.en: The homepage describes surveys, message tests, preference tests, brand tracking and interviews. It says participants are verified through corporate email and LinkedIn, with human review of audience matches. These are vendor-described recruitment controls, not an independently audited guarantee of representativeness. Check the audience picker for the actual role and industry combination before writing a study around assumed availability.
sections.zh: 首页介绍问卷、文案测试、偏好测试、品牌跟踪和访谈，并说明通过企业邮箱和 LinkedIn 验证参与者，由人工检查人群匹配。这是厂商描述的招募控制，并非独立审计的人群代表性保证。应先在选择器核对实际职位与行业组合，再围绕可用人群设计研究。

sections.title_en: Example: test a developer-tool value proposition
sections.title_zh: 示例：测试开发者工具的价值主张
sections.en: Define whether the buyer is an engineering manager or an individual developer, then show the same landing-page proposition to that audience. Ask what the product does, when it would matter and what remains unclear. Review the reasons behind scores and revise one confusing claim before another round. A stated preference is not an observed purchase, and combining unrelated job roles can hide meaningful differences. No test was purchased here.
sections.zh: 先确定买家是工程经理还是一线开发者，再向对应人群展示相同落地页主张。询问产品做什么、何时有用以及哪里不清楚。查看评分背后的理由，修改一个模糊主张后再开展下一轮。表达偏好不等于实际购买，把无关职位混在一起也可能掩盖重要差异。本文未购买测试。

sections.title_zh: 年度 credits 预算与按次付费
sections.en: The pricing page shows Pro at $20,000/year with 20,000 credits and Elite at $40,000/year with 27,000 credits plus advisory services. It defines one credit as one dollar of test cost, but the subscription price and granted credit balance are not necessarily equal. Pay-as-you-go has no subscription and is described as costing 50% more per test than Pro. Actual test counts depend on sample size and seniority, so dividing an annual price by a generic test count would mislead.
sections.zh: 定价页列出 Pro 每年 20,000 美元含 20,000 credits；Elite 每年 40,000 美元含 27,000 credits 并附咨询服务。页面把一个 credit 定义为一美元的测试费用，但订阅价格与授予的 credits 并不一定相等。按次付费无需订阅，描述为每次测试比 Pro 贵 50%。实际测试次数受样本量和职位级别影响，不能用一个通用次数去平摊年费。

sections.title_en: Separate self-service research from managed programs
sections.title_zh: 区分自助研究与托管服务
sections.en: Wynter Black is advertised at $100,000/year with a research strategist and managed work; it is not the same deliverable as a single self-service message test. The pricing FAQ says running tests with your own panel is free, which does not include access to Wynter recruited buyers. Start by verifying audience availability and a complete-response quote. Retention, export rights and contractual data handling remain to be checked; marketed turnaround and conversion case studies were not independently tested here.
sections.zh: Wynter Black 宣传每年 100,000 美元，包含研究策略师和托管工作，与单次自助文案测试并非相同交付物。定价 FAQ 写使用自有样本开展测试免费，这不包含 Wynter 招募买家。入门时应先核对目标人群和完整回复报价。保留期限、导出权和合同数据处理仍待确认；宣传交付时效和转化案例未在本文中独立测试。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source documentation research, original English synthesis and Chinese translation; examples are hypothetical and unexecuted.

research_gaps.en: Verify the exact buyer audience, test quote, incentives, credit expiry and contractual research-data rights.
research_gaps.zh: 需确认具体买家人群、测试报价、激励、credits 到期和研究数据合同权利。

research_gaps.en: No live account, purchase, recovery or performance test was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未实际创建账户、购买、测试恢复或测量性能。
